title: DMDM Hydantoin and Hair Loss: What the Research Shows

seo_description: No study links DMDM hydantoin to hair loss. See what patch-test and risk-assessment research says about skin allergy from this preservative.
notes: Citation style v2: 3 studies, each cited once, all in the second half; Key Takeaways and FAQ carry no links.
Merge target; old post claimed DMDM hydantoin causes hair loss and offered ways to 'combat' it; no source supports that, so the article corrects the frame.
flags: COMPLIANCE: the old post asserted a causal hair-loss link with no support. The rewrite says no study found one.
